name: PT Hasnur Internasional Shipping Tbk
summary: PT Hasnur Internasional Shipping Tbk, an Indonesian firm, specializes in providing end-to-end logistics and transportation services for commodities, leveraging both riverine and maritime routes. Its business is organized into two primary divisions: shipping operations and the handling of cargo loading and unloading. The company was established in 2009 and its principal office is situated in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia.
